title: Bitcoin Realized Volatility Challenger & Model Confidence Set Benchmark (24H vs 168H)

primary_loss_function.name: QLIKE
primary_loss_function.formula: L(y, y_hat) = y / y_hat - ln(y / y_hat) - 1
primary_loss_function.literature_source: Patton (2011) - Volatility forecast comparison using imperfect volatility proxies (DOI: 10.1016/j.jeconom.2010.03.034)

evaluation_protocols.pairwise_test: Diebold-Mariano (1995) with Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold (1997) finite-sample correction and Student's t_{T-1} reference distribution
evaluation_protocols.multi_model_test: Hansen, Lunde, Nason (2011) Model Confidence Set (MCS) at alpha = 0.05

acceptance_criteria.production_lock: Challengers remain OFFLINE_RESEARCH_ONLY until >= 100 clean prospective blocks accumulate
